title: WildProof: Go Outside With a Question, Come Back With Evidence
why_read: A hackathon-style offline field-observation app with a thoughtful design around uncertainty, but limited broad technical novelty.
analysis: WildProof is an offline-first app for recording field observations like nature walks, explicitly structured to separate directly observed facts from AI-inferred guesses and unknowns. The idea of being transparent about confidence levels in AI-assisted analysis is a reasonable design principle, though it's not a particularly novel technical contribution. It reads as a hackathon submission (for a Hacktoberfest challenge) focused on product concept and UX rather than deep technical innovation. Still, the observed/inferred/unknown framing for AI outputs is a decent small pattern worth noting for anyone building similar tools.
